subject: patient1
description: COMBINE-v1: LEAN-v107-FUTCUBELONG + 2nd-order Morlet scattering block ported from SCAT-v103. Scattering computes dense S1 envelopes (Q1=4/oct, 50-12.8kHz), sub-set j1 paths (every 4 → K=9), S2 modulation paths (Q2=1/oct 0.5-4096Hz, fc2<fc1/2 mask) with mean/std/peak normalized by S1, joint-TF Δj1, intra-frame contour, S1 sub-set log mean/peak, instantaneous frequency / fc, Fisher-transformed phase coherence, IF jitter, S2 entropy. Standalone LEAN-v107≈0.0878, standalone SCAT-v103≈0.0882. STUB:v107-FUTCUBELONG: v100 + future-shifted CUBE-ROOT LONG cochleagram contrast. 5 dim raw. Running best v100=0.08776. STUB:v100-FUTMINUSCUR: v96 + (future MED contrast - current LONG contrast). 5 dim raw. Running best v96=0.08775. STUB:v96-FUTMED6: v92 + future-shifted MED cochleagram contrast k=6 (200ms). 5 dim raw. Running best v92=0.08769. STUB:v92-FUTCONTRASTMED: v89 + future-shifted MED cochleagram contrast (k=3). 5 dim raw. Running best v89=0.08765. STUB:v89-FUTCONTRAST: v84 + cochleagram contrast on FUTURE-shifted log_e (k=3). 5 dim raw. Running best v84=0.08751. STUB:v84-TOPBOTSHORT: v82 + TOP-2/BOT-2 on SHORT cochleagram. 10 dim raw. Running best v82=0.08749. STUB:v82-TOPBOT: v67 + separate TOP-2 and BOT-2 cochleagram bands per group. 10 dim raw. Running best v67=0.08747. STUB:v67-MEDADAPTCONTRAST: v64 + adapt-delta contrast on MEDIUM 2048 window (tau=4.5). 5 dim raw. Running best v64=0.08744. STUB:v64-MULTITAUCONTRAST: v55 + adapt-delta cochleagram contrast at 2 taus (1.5/15). 10 dim raw. Running best v55=0.08742. STUB:v55-SHORTCOCHLEACONTRAST: v54 + cochleagram contrast on SHORT 1024 window. 20 dim raw. Running best v54 = 0.08739. STUB:v54-MEDCOCHLEACONTRAST: v52 + cochleagram contrast on MEDIUM 2048 window. 20 dim raw. Running best v52 = 0.08724. STUB:v52-COCHLEACONTRAST: v46 + cochleagram-band peak-valley contrast in 5 groups of 4 channels + multi-tau dyn. 20 dim raw. Running best v46 = 0.08719. STUB:v46-MEDCONTRAST: v45 + spectral contrast on MEDIUM 2048 window. 24 dim raw. Running best v45 = 0.08706. STUB:v45-SHORTCONTRAST: v44 + spectral contrast on SHORT 1024 window + multi-tau dyn. 24 dim raw. Running best v44 = 0.08702. STUB:v44-CONTRAST: v33 + spectral contrast (top 25% vs bottom 25% log-power) per 6 octaves + multi-tau dyn. 24 dim raw. Running best v33 = 0.08686. STUB:v33-REGIONFLAT: v32-CPP + region-specific spectral flatness (high 4-8kHz, low 60-500Hz) + multi-tau dyn. 8 dim raw. Running best v32-CPP = 0.08671. STUB:v32-CPP: LEAN-v17 + Cepstral Peak Prominence (1 scalar) + multi-tau dyn. 4 dim raw. Canonical voice-quality measure. Running best v17 = 0.08665. STUB:INTERP final4: same v2z stage-2 block confirmed best after 6 additional iterations (v2ss/v2tt/v2uu/v2vv/v2ww/v2xx/v2yy). Best new variant v2xx (phon × key-sig curated products) = 0.0776 (+0.0001), within ±0.0008 paired-bootstrap noise; medium block (240 dim) does NOT meet +0.0015 real-gain threshold. Composition v2yy (v2vv multi-lag + v2xx) also 0.0776 — no extra gain. Other iterations: v2ss (cross-tau dev) 0.0774, v2tt (onset-gated asym) 0.0773, v2uu (derivative cross-products) 0.0774, v2vv (multi-scale cross-lag) 0.0775, v2ww (4-summary-band dev asym) 0.0771. The v2z plateau at 0.0775 (=+0.0015 over baseline) is the interpretable ceiling reachable from the LEAN signal set; closing the remaining gap to the Whisper learned-feature ceiling (~0.0821) would require richer interpretable signal extraction at the front-end (not new interactions on existing summaries). cond_mode=none. STUB:INTERP final3 = LEAN-v16 + v2z stage-2 interaction block. v2z = (a) v2m raw asymmetric: 10 zero-mean key sigs (loud, pitch-strength, logF0, flux_abs, voicing, centroid, flat, HNR_dB, F2-F1, F1+F2) × {ReLU(z+), ReLU(z-), z^3} = 30; (b) MULTI-SCALE deviation asymmetric: for each of (10 key sigs + 5 phonetic templates + 4 formant sigs) × 3 taus (4.5/15/60 = phonetic/syllabic/word) × 3 asym = 171; (c) v2j cross-lag: 6 phonetic-scale (k=2≈67ms) products. Total 207 raw → 828 post-delay. Stage 3 (per-group rescaling) inert under the per-chunk z-score harness — only column-replication can re-condition, gave within-noise gains (v1a/b kept as reference). Stage 2 explored 31 sets (v2a..v2ii); the WIN was v2v's composition of raw asym + multi-scale dev asym (v2v=0.0772, +0.0006 over v2m=0.0766), then v2z extends asym pool to phonetic templates and formants (each +0.0001). Larger pools (v2aa/v2ee/v2ff/v2hh) and band-pass (v2ff), RBF (v2ee), triple products (v2s) all overfit. v2z test_corr=0.0775 = +0.0015 over INTERP-v0-baseline=0.0760 — meets the real-gain threshold. Every feature is an explicit, NAMED acoustic quantity at a named time scale. Final confirmation runs v2jj (dev-level cross-lag, 0.0774) and v2kk (multi-lag cross-lag k=2,4, 0.0775) added no gain; plateau at 0.0775 confirmed. GRID-ONLY
